# LCA ball joint reinstallation alignment

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Push LCA down to align grooved portion then install bolt ensuring end faces forward. [t856]

## Tips & gotchas

- Rotate the LCA until you find an angle that allows the balljoint to come free despite the CV shaft being in the way. [t856]
- If alignment is difficult, cut off the ball joint nub with a sawzall and rip it out as a last resort. [t856]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Installing the bolt end facing backward through the knuckle hole instead of forward. [t856]
